seo_title: AI Utility Audit Agent for Small Businesses | LANZA
seo_desc: Stop overpaying for electricity and gas. We integrate an AI agent that audits utility bills and automates claims for your business.
author_pitch: Large utility corporations count on you not having the time to check every single kilowatt-hour on your bill. I have designed an artificial intelligence system that reads your contracts, analyzes real consumption, and executes claims for you without you lifting a finger.
title: AI Utility Audit Agent: Protect Your Small Business Margins
body:
¿Are you certain that your electricity, gas, and telecom bills match what you actually contracted?

Each month, thousands of freelancers and small businesses overpay on their utility bills due to billing errors, incorrectly applied power terms, or additional services charged without authorization. Manually reviewing hundreds of pages of technical breakdowns is unfeasible for a business, causing a silent and constant loss of liquidity that directly damages your net profit.

The Trap of Manual Review

Trusting that large utility companies will always apply the correct rates is a costly mistake, and delegating this to a traditional agency is ineffective because they lack the technological tools to audit consumption hour by hour. Leaving the control of your operational costs in the hands of traditional paperwork is a guaranteed money drain.

Our Solution: Automated Utility Audit

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we develop and integrate a custom artificial intelligence agent that completely takes over the supervision and optimization of your electrical and telecommunications expenses.

  1. Smart contract reading: The system processes the PDF files of your current contracts and accurately extracts the agreed prices for each period.
  2. Real consumption analysis: The agent connects through integration with the utility distributors databases to cross-reference every hour of real consumption against what was billed.
  3. Automated anomaly detection: It instantly identifies unjustified penalties, unilateral price increases, or mismatches in the contracted power.
  4. Autonomous claims management: It drafts and sends the formal claim document to the utility company customer service department.

The Real Impact on Operational Expenses

  • Recovery of erroneously charged amounts: Direct refund to your bank account of unjustified charges applied by utility companies.
  • Guaranteed recurring savings: Optimization of contracted power and rates to reduce the fixed monthly cost of the business.
  • Zero hours lost on the phone: The team forgets about endless support calls; the artificial intelligence handles the entire process.
